test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The classical theory of monsoon development was propounded by Sir Edmond Halley. With this reference, which of the following statements is/are correct?

1. During the summer monsoon, the air flows from the sea to land and brings heavy rainfall to the Indian subcontinent.

2. During the winter monsoon, the air flows from land to sea and carries very little moisture.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both 1 and 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• During the **summer monsoon**, the air flows from the **sea to land**, influenced by the differential heating of land and water. This airflow brings heavy rainfall to the Indian subcontinent due to the moisture-laden winds from the Indian Ocean. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• During the **winter monsoon**, the air flows from the **land to the sea**. As the land cools faster than the ocean during winter, high-pressure systems develop over land, pushing dry air towards the sea. This airflow carries **very little moisture**, resulting in dry conditions. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• The monsoon phenomenon is majorly driven by the **Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)**, which shifts north and south seasonally, influencing the direction and intensity of monsoon winds.</
